title: Pixel Dissolve
description: Ảnh được cắt thành lưới 4 × 4, từng ô bật to từ tâm và hiện dần theo một thứ tự ngẫu nhiên cố định, cuối cùng ghép kín không khe.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio pixel-dissolve, written here): Target cut into 4 x 4 tiles (each shows its own part of the picture). Tiles appear in a fixed seeded random order; tile k starts at k x 28 ms, scale 0 -> 1 about its own centre + opacity 0 -> 1 over 450 ms easeOutCubic; ~900 ms total; at the end the tiles join with no gaps (swap to the whole picture). Exit: same in a scrambled order, 200 ms each, 12 ms apart, ease-in cubic. Params: grid (4 × 4) · stagger (28 ms) · duration mỗi ô (0.45 s) · seed. At the end the tiles are swapped for the whole element, so no seams show.
